stage1.impression: A warm, slatted-oak room with two red acrylic speakers on terrazzo plinths and a wire-frame globe with saturated blue, green, yellow and pink rims between them. It reads as a clean CG showroom, not a photograph: the slats are smooth and grainless, the terrazzo speckle is uniform and procedural, the speakers' insides glow a flat clipped pink, the horns show wobbly refractions, and the globe's rims read as neon signage. No listener, glass or record is visible, so it says generic render-bar, not a specific, well-made place a magazine would publish.

blocking_9: Oak slat walls show real grain, per-slat tone variation and soft falloff; the upper wall is no brighter than the speakers (wall band [340,0,1200,200] lum_median below the speaker region's)
Speaker inner faces hold detail: clip_pct < 0.5 in [290,360,430,555] and [900,340,1130,610]
Light builds pools on the subjects and floor with dark between them, frame lum_median 32 to 45
Mother EARF's coloured shadow is visible on the end-grain floor, and her rims read as lit acrylic edges, not neon tubes
Terrazzo reads as honed stone at real chip scale, not a noise texture
Signs of life: a legible (blurred) listener, a glass, a record out of its sleeve
End-grain floor and rug read as their materials, not flat brown planes

defects.what: Upper slat wall is the brightest large area in the frame (lum_median 78) and hotter than the speakers; slats are smooth, uniform, grainless CG
Left speaker's inner top face clipped (clip_pct 10.9, r_median 249): flat pink plastic look
Right speaker clips 2.8 %; interior panels flat pink with no thickness or edge glow
Left horn shows wobbly, distorted refraction of the slats (cheap-plastic read)
Right horn: same wobbly striped refraction
Mother EARF's rims read as saturated neon tubes (blue, green, yellow, pink); disc bodies read as brown slats, not tinted acrylic
Mother's plinth and the floor in front are dark (lum_median 18); no coloured shadow on the floor
Floor and rug are flat featureless brown; end grain not legible
Black shelf slab on the left reads as a floating untextured box
Foreground blurred shape is unreadable; the listener the card calls for does not register

changes.problem: No sign of life: no visible listener, glass or record, so the room reads as a showroom.

changes.problem: No atmosphere: beams and pools have no air, so the light reads computed.

evidence.measured: hard-edged wall light, crush_pct 6.5 in slat gaps

out_of_scope.request: Make one EARF product the only saturated colour
out_of_scope.why: The card fixes one Tropos pair in Ember plus Mother EARF with tinted, glowing rims; two red speakers and four rim colours are the products as placed.

out_of_scope.request: Thicker horns with clean, undistorted refraction
out_of_scope.why: The horn's shape is the speaker itself (and the waveguide shape is fixed by acoustics); only lighting behind it can be changed.

out_of_scope.request: Mother EARF's discs reading as tinted acrylic rather than brown
out_of_scope.why: Her material and part design are the product; only her spot and rim emission levels may change.
